original_title: Senegal students protest scholarship delays amid rising youth discontent

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Protests by students at Cheikh Anta Diop University in Dakar due to delayed scholarship payments have turned violent, resulting in the death of a medical student. The situation is tense, with authorities ordering students to leave campus.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Escalation of protests and potential clashes between students and police, leading to disruptions in the city, particularly around the university area.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Prolonged unrest could impact the stability of the region, affecting not only the education sector but also the broader social and economic landscape of Senegal.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Potential disruptions to ground transportation and logistics in and around Dakar, especially if protests spread beyond the university campus. Aviation operations at Blaise Diagne International Airport may not be directly affected but could be indirectly impacted by the general unrest.
ai_analysis.proximity_alert: YAKIN TEHDİT: Blaise Diagne International Airport (8 km)
